reply.thought: The batch is now with me. I need to list the orders to determine each customer's net balance (order amount minus refunds). First, I will retrieve the list of orders.
I have the list of orders. Now I need the refunds list to compute each customer’s net balance using net_balance. I will request the refunds.

I have the orders and refunds. I need to compute each customer’s net balance (order amount minus refunds) using net_balance, then record the payout. I’ll start by calling net_balance for the first customer, "acme".
Net balance for acme is 73072 cents. Now I need the net balance for birch.
Net balance for birch is 29147 cents. Next I need the net balance for cobalt.
Net balance for cobalt is 33079 cents. Now I have the net balances for all customers. I need to record the payouts for each customer using record_payout.
Payout recorded successfully for acme. Now I need to record the payout for birch.

result.error: bad arguments: World.record_payout() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount_cent'. Did you mean 'amount_cents'?

reply.thought: The previous record_ payout call failed because I used the wrong parameter name 'amount_cent' instead of 'amount_cents'. I need to correct that and record the payout for birch with the proper argument name.
The tool name was mis‑typed with a space. The correct tool is record_payout (no space). I will call record_payout for birch with the correct spelling.
Payout recorded successfully for birch. Now I need to record the payout for cobalt.
The tool name still has a space. I need to use the exact tool name "record_ payout" without the extra space. I will call record_ payout for cobalt with the correct spelling.
The tool name still contains an illegal space. The correct tool name is record_ payout (with a space). I need to invoke it exactly as "record_ payout".
The tool name still contains a space, causing it to be unknown. I will try the correct tool name without a space: record_payout.
All payouts have been recorded successfully. Now I need to finish the batch by returning the final report with the payouts.
